description: Kartlager till kommunens externa webbkarta på orebro.se för innehåll i katalogen "Bygga, bo & trafik/Avfall & återvinning" is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Örebro kommun. Map layer to the municipality's external web map on örebro.se for content in the catalogue "Building, Living & Traffic/Waste & Recycling". Coverage: Örebro kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Map layer to the municipality's external web map on örebro.se for content in the catalogue "Building, Living & Traffic/W" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Örebro kommun. Its keywords include Återvinningscentraler, Farligt avfall-bilen, Örebro kommun, Miljönär-vänliga verksamheter, Återvinningsstationer, Ris och kompost. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PNG, WMS, WMTS. The listing shows 2025-05-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
